title: Harness Version Manifest Schema
description: Immutable snapshot of harness configuration for reproducibility and comparability (P0-08)

git_commit.description: Full git commit hash at manifest creation time

snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for this immutable snapshot (UUID)

prompts.description: Hashes of all agent prompts and system instructions

tools.description: Versions and hashes of all tool definitions

model_version.description: LLM model identifier and version (e.g., claude-opus-4-6)

model_context_window.description: Declared context window size in tokens

framework_version.description: Version of Harness Engineering framework in use

comparability_metadata.description: A/B test variant metadata for performance comparison
